name: Col2ImOverlap3x3
adaptation: Fold four overlapping 2x2 patches into a 3x3 single-channel image with stride 1, no padding and dilation 1. The sixteen input INT8 cells form an ONNX column matrix [kernel_element, patch_index] of shape [4,4]. Kernel element k=2*i+j and patch p=2*h+w are row-major; cell (k,p) occupies byte 4*k+p. It contributes to output location (h+i,w+j). Sum every overlapping contribution, do not average or overwrite. Output is all nine row-major signed INT16 sums; there is no overflow in this domain.
